entries.title: Preserver
entries.description: Retains supported and unsupported material without silently changing or discarding it.
required_operations: preserve unknown material inertly or refuse the import

entries.title: Producer
entries.description: Creates stable portable IDs and valid source submissions before archive admission.

entries.title: Processor
entries.description: Creates derived assertions with exact evidence and an honest authority basis.
required_operations: link derived output to exact evidence

entries.title: Importer/Exporter
entries.description: Transfers Capsules or mindpacks with explicit completeness, dependency, and losslessness reporting.

entries.title: Archive
entries.description: Admits canonical objects and, at higher levels, maintains verifiable archive history.
required_operations: keep archive-local coordinates outside portable identity

entries.title: Policy Evaluator
entries.description: Evaluates the pinned policy model and maintains generation-fence behavior.
